title: Reuse test/helpers/overflow_harness.dart instead of hand-rolling single-point FlutterError.onError overflow checks in lifetime_folder_styled_and_notif_providers_test.dart
why: coding-standards.md TQ-3 specifies test/helpers/pump_app.dart as 'the reviewed convention' for widget-test pumping, but that file does not exist anywhere in the repo (only an unrelated pumpApp lives in test/e2e/harness/e2e_harness.dart for E2E journeys) — this file's local _wrap/_pump/_tearDown (lines 53-86) is a from-scratch reimplementation. Separately, 6 tests (lines 147, 269, 343, 507, 797, 1146) hand-roll a FlutterError.onError capture to detect RTL overflow at exactly one (size, textScale) point, duplicating and weakening test/helpers/overflow_harness.dart's expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices — an already-adopted (18 call sites), purpose-built matrix checker with a documented central home at test/overflow/overflow_guard_test.dart. The hand-rolled single-point checks in this file cannot catch overflow that only manifests at the tablet width or the 2.0x text-scale corner, which the shared matrix helper is specifically designed to catch.
recommendation: Add the 6 Hebrew-locale/dark-theme cases to test/overflow/overflow_guard_test.dart via expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices instead of the local FlutterError.onError pattern; separately, either build test/helpers/pump_app.dart per TQ-3's spec or point TQ-3 at overflow_harness.dart's _wrap-equivalent so future widget tests have one place to look.
acceptance_criteria: The 6 sites at lines 147/269/343/507/797/1146 are replaced by expectNoOverflowAcrossDevices calls (in this file or test/overflow/overflow_guard_test.dart).
A shared, importable pump helper exists and this file imports it rather than defining its own _wrap/_pump.
